name: Steam
description: Soft wisps of steam lifting from the bottom edge in front of your content, curling and thinning as they rise.

props.name: density
props.description: How much steam rises, from 0 to 1. Even at 1 it stays translucent, so content behind it can be read.

props.name: rise
props.description: Multiplier for how fast the steam lifts. At 1 it rises about 50 pixels a second near the water and slows as it climbs.

props.name: sway
props.description: Strength of the slow cross-breeze that leans the wisps one way and then the other, from 0 to 2.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the steam. Without it, a cool blue-grey by day and a pale white at night. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the steam. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content the steam rises in front of. Moving the pointer through it stirs the steam. Set text over the steam in the foreground colour: muted text falls below 4.5:1 once steam passes in front of it.
